subject: prd/forgejo-feature-draft
statement: When a prepared draft is merged, the system shall identify exactly one same-repository merged PR on the selected host, verify the operator's authenticated review of its exact prepared head, verify compiled records and ancestry on mainline, then publish or byte-verify an annotated lock tag for that merge.
fit_criterion: Missing/multiple PRs, stale/agent/rejected reviews, unmatched records/digest, non-ancestor merge, and conflicting tag refuse; valid squash merge yields one tag with head/digest/review/PR/mainline commit; rerun idempotent.
